intro.alt: Tarikul Islam, Software Engineer & Full-Stack Developer
intro.caption: FULL-STACK · BACKEND · CLOUD · MCP
intro.p1: I’m |||, a Software Engineer & Full-Stack Developer from Dhaka, Bangladesh. I focus on backend development with Node.js, NestJS, and TypeScript, and build product interfaces with React and Next.js.
intro.p2: I enjoy building complete applications, from designing data models and REST APIs to creating intuitive interfaces. I also work with cloud deployments and develop custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers to connect AI assistants with external tools and services.
intro.p3: My recent work includes education, streaming, and community platforms, along with custom MCP integrations such as Google Calendar and local file-system tools. Away from the code, I’m studying at Bangladesh University of Business & Technology.
